answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Proof of unique nursing license renewal flips the bet — a license renewed biennially with employment to match — and the tundra lands on the attacker instead. Each account presents its proof once, the network verifies it in seconds, and a farm that wants ten accounts must pass ten independent checks — the marble is that the work cannot be shared or replayed. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the raven of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
